THE QUARTER

Industrial heritage.
Made for modern life.

Volta transforms a historic industrial district into a mixed residential and business quarter. Contemporary residences sit alongside restored limestone architecture, park space, cafés, wellness, sport and everyday services.

COMFORT & EFFICIENCY

Built for lower energy use.
Designed for easier living.

A-energy-class residences combine smart-home controls, rooftop solar, underground parking and practical bicycle and stroller storage. Top-floor homes include integrated cooling, while EV charging can be added where available.
